PART I
Item 1.    Business
Company Overview

Simulated Widgets Inc. designs, manufactures and sells simulated widgets to industrial customers. The Company’s fiscal year ends on December 31.

The Company sells through direct sales teams and a network of independent distributors in three regions.

For a discussion of risks, see Part I, Item 1A of this Form 10-K under the heading “Risk Factors.”

Item 1A.
Risk Factors

Investing in a simulated company involves risks. The risks below could harm the business.

Supply of simulated parts may be interrupted. A single supplier provides most simulated parts, and a disruption at that supplier would delay shipments.

Item 7 of this report discusses how input costs affected margins.
